IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Williams, Rodne, Simpson, Moeller, O'Brien, Kirby and Kenney

Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning polygraph examinations of sexual assault victims.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to polygraph examinations of sexual assaultvictims; and adding a new section to chapter 10.58 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 10.58 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A law enforcement officer, prosecuting attorney, or othergovernment official may not ask or require a victim of an alleged sexoffense to submit to a polygraph examination or other truth tellingdevice as a condition for proceeding with the investigation of theoffense. The refusal of a victim to submit to a polygraph examinationor other truth telling device shall not prevent the investigation,charging, or prosecution of the offense. For the purposes of thissection, "sex offense" is any offense under chapter 9A.44 RCW.
